name: button-highlight
purpose: Visually emphasized action trigger built on a brand-accent gradient with a continuously rotating multicolor glow rim behind the surface (ported from the `azion-console-kit` Copilot button). Use it to draw attention to a primary AI / highlight flow that needs to stand out from a regular `Button`. One visual treatment (the gradient + glow); same prop surface as `Button` minus the `kind` axis.
useWhen: The single entry point to an AI assistant or highlight flow (for example "Ask Azion") that must stand out from the actions around it.
A headline action in a header or marketing band where a primary `button` would blend in.
avoidWhen: A regular primary or secondary action → use `button`.
A default action with related alternatives in a menu → use `split-button`.
related: button` — the default action control; adds `kind`, `iconPosition`, `animated`, `type` and a `prefix` slot that this component does not have.
icon-button` — icon-only action when there is no room for a label.
bestPractices: Use at most one per view; the glow loses its meaning when it repeats.
Keep the label short and verb-led, and pair it with a leading `icon` (for example `pi pi-sparkles`).
It always renders `type="button"`; use `button` with `type="submit"` to submit a form.
disabled` and `loading` both hide the glow, apply the disabled surface and suppress `click`.
The glow stops under reduced motion, so never use it to convey state.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label text. Required — use `IconButton` for icon-only controls.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects height, padding, and typography.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows loading state and disables activation.

props.name: icon
props.doc: PrimeIcons class for the leading icon.

props.name: href
props.doc: When set, renders as an anchor link.

events.name: click
events.notes: Fires on activation; suppressed when `disabled` or `loading`.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ButtonHighlight from '@aziontech/webkit/button-highlight'
</script>

<template>
  <ButtonHighlight
    size="large"
    label="Ask Azion"
    icon="pi pi-sparkles"
  />
</template>
